title: lockfile
description: Runs the workspace-level targets of a Cargo workspace that never join a batch, in the workspace's root folder: lockfile lets cargo update --workspace bring Cargo.lock up to date and writes a digest of each member's locked dependencies, which the cached targets of the members read; hakari-check checks the hack crate of cargo-hakari; coverage-baseline brings the coverage baseline of the affected tests up to date with cargo affected collect.

features.description: Features to activate, passed as --features. Set the same as the test runs of the workspace. Taken by coverage-baseline.

allFeatures.description: Activate all features, passed as --all-features. Set the same as the test runs of the workspace. Taken by coverage-baseline.

noDefaultFeatures.description: Do not activate the default features, passed as --no-default-features. Set the same as the test runs of the workspace. Taken by coverage-baseline.

profile.description: The Cargo profile to build with, passed as --cargo-profile. Set the same as the test runs of the workspace. Taken by coverage-baseline.

fullCollect.description: Always collect the coverage of every test into an empty database, never cargo affected collect --diff, as for a nightly run. Taken by coverage-baseline.

diffOnly.description: Collect only with cargo affected collect --diff, and collect nothing where it cannot run, leaving a full collection to a run with --fullCollect. Taken by coverage-baseline.

fullCollectThreshold.description: How many commits the oldest collection of the baseline may lie behind HEAD before a full collection replaces cargo affected collect --diff. The inferred target sets 100. Taken by coverage-baseline.

separateBuildDir.description: Build the instrumented tests in a build directory of their own, target/affected/build, also where Cargo's configuration sets build.build-dir. Taken by coverage-baseline.

pluginVersion.description: The plugin's version, which the plugin sets for the cache key. Not meant to be set by hand.
